title: Travis Walton was dead and revived

tellings.quote: In Dr. in um Travis Walton's case, Dr. Leer thinks he or he was dead and they brought him back to life.

plain: A doctor named Roger Leir believed that Travis Walton, the man at the center of a 1975 case in Arizona, had actually died and was then brought back to life by whoever had him. This is a second-hand account. A scientist named Steve Colbern tells Michels what Leir thought: "Dr. Leir thinks he was dead and they brought him back to life." If it were true, the beings in such cases could reverse death itself.
